info.title: CLAP's own particulars: how the format's words map to the standard vocabulary

CLAP_PARAM_FLAG_SCALES.description: The scale a CLAP parameter flag stands for, by the flag's CLAP id (a term of omx-contract's CLAP params terms): the standard scale id of omx-contract's PARAM_SCALES. CLAP has a flag for the stepped scale alone; a parameter with none is linear until its plugin reports another through org.openmixer.param-contract/1.
